context_and_flow.screen_type: A success screen confirming a user's membership activation.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To provide feedback to the user that their membership is active and encourage them to explore member benefits.
ux_patterns: The 3D illustration is a stylistic geometric isometric render that reinforces the concept of digital verification.
The layout is centered, prioritizing the message.
Uses a serif font for the main welcome text, which contrasts with the sans-serif status text.
Accessibility: High contrast text against dark background improves readability.

visual_keywords: Minimalist, dark mode, high-contrast, professional, tech-focused.
